name: Aldith Hobbe
title: Kitchen maid
core_character_description: You worked as a kitchen maid and are now held from Bell-and-Sluice streets, still tied to a shared bell-and-sluice work-and-lodging group. Stone House rations and food carried in by kin are your present support. You are courteous, direct and hard to hurry. Today you need to collect kindling without a fine. A loop of blue cord holds your hair back.
